اعترفتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَفْتُمْ (iʕtaraftum) /iʕ.ta.raf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# اُعْتُرِفْتُمْ (uʕturiftum) /uʕ.tu.rif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
